mapper.sql: external_id AS id, api_key_ref_uuid AS workspace_api_key_uuid, organization_uuid AS org_uuid, workspace_uuid, workspace_display_id, name, key_prefix, key_suffix, status, created_by_user_ref_uuid AS created_by_user_uuid, last_used_at, expires_at, archived_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO console_api_keys ( external_id, api_key_ref_uuid, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, workspace_display_id, name, key_prefix, key_suffix, key_hash, status, created_by_user_ref_uuid, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.APIKeyUUID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceDisplayID}, #{params.Name}, #{params.KeyPrefix,sensitive=true}, #{params.KeySuffix,sensitive=true}, #{params.KeyHash,sensitive=true}, 'active', #{params.CreatedByUserUUID}, #{params.ExpiresAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE console_api_keys SET status = #{params.Status}, archived_at = CASE WHEN #{params.Status} = 'archived' THEN COALESCE(archived_at, NOW()) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE organization_uuid = #{params.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND external_id = #{params.ExternalID} RETURNING
